section_summary.extract_value: Study 1 evaluated a state version of the BAS-2 (referred to as the SBAS-2), focusing on its factor structure, internal consistency, convergent validity, and incremental validity. The study also examined sex differences in state body appreciation and hypothesized that state BA would correlate positively with life satisfaction and self-esteem, negatively with BMI, and that men and women would show similar levels of state BA.
